title: Microsoft Copilot Chat in Outlook: reasoning over inbox, calendar and enterprise data (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: Hold: the briefing turns an unpublished meter into an unsupported assurance that no spending control applies, and overstates which accessible email can ground answers. It also excludes hybrid users too broadly; the documented exclusion concerns primary mailboxes hosted on-premises. The roadmap details, licensing entitlement and printed control paths and command are supported.

claims.claim: The printed Purview route reaches the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork policy location.
claims.quote: Go to Data Loss Prevention > Policies and select + Create policy. Select the Custom template, then Custom policy. On the Locations page, set the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork location to on.
claims.fix: Keep the documented route, but clarify its stopping point in the note: 'This route selects the policy location. Add a rule using Content contains > Sensitivity labels and Prevent Copilot and Cowork from processing content to exclude labelled items. External-email rules use Email is received from > External users and Prevent Copilot from processing content.' These further choices are documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-microsoft365-copilot-location-learn-about.

claims.claim: The printed New-DLPComplianceRule call is the cited policy reference's example for a Copilot sensitivity-label processing restriction.
claims.quote: New-DLPComplianceRule -Name "Copilot Rule" -Policy "Copilot Policy" -AdvancedRule $advrule -RestrictAccess @(@{setting="ExcludeContentProcessing";value="Block"})

claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Chat Outlook inbox calendar expansion 554934 default enabled admin switch limit open email reasoning; "Copilot Chat" "Outlook" "reasoning" "disable". Read configure-copilot-admin-center, manage-copilot-chat, privacy-and-protections and release entry; no expansion-only switch.

claims.claim: The pinning page documents Copilot > Settings > Pin Microsoft Copilot Chat in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Go to Copilot > Settings. Select Pin Microsoft Copilot Chat.

Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/implement/pin-copilot-chat-navbar.

claims.claim: Unpinning is not a reliable way to prevent access to Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: If you choose this option, Copilot Chat won't be available by default for users in Teams and Outlook. Users can still visit their app store and add Copilot themselves.

claims.claim: The Copilot package block API requires a Microsoft Agent 365 licence.
claims.quote: Access to the Package Management API requires a Microsoft Agent 365 license.

claims.claim: The package block documentation does not establish that this API blocks the Copilot app itself.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Graph Integrated Apps Copilot app availability users groups block API PowerShell; "Copilot app" "Integrated" "API" availability block. Read copilotPackage:block and Integrated Apps; the API describes blocking a Copilot package, not the first-party Copilot app.

claims.claim: Copilot DLP policy scoping follows the user submitting the prompt, not the owner of the accessed email.
claims.quote: DLP policy scoping for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Cowork is based on the user who submits the prompt, not the owner of a file or email that the experience accesses.

claims.claim: The prepare action rating fits a rolling-out expansion with medium risk and an immediate app-availability decision.
claims.quote: action: "prepare"; status: "rolling-out"; risk: "medium"; Decide whether the Copilot app stays installable by all users or only a licensed group, using the Integrated Apps availability row.
claims.fix: Set action to act-now: the item is already Rolling out, expands existing users' data access, is rated medium risk, and the briefing identifies an availability decision and DLP configuration to make before it reaches users. Keep the feature-specific default as unknown.
